output.summary: The zero-deviation record is most likely an artifact of the February 2026 supervisor bonus penalty, which punishes each deviation report. It does not show better quality. Rising customer complaints (E11), rising independent QC rejections (E12), the 30% purchasing increase (E10), the collapse in speak-up survey scores (E16) and the hotline report (E8) all point to suppressed reporting. Line 3's 118% plan attainment is explained by unrecorded labor borrowed from Lines 1 and 4 (E13, E14), not by transferable practices. Tubing and training do not fit the timing or the line pattern. The Plant Manager's knowledge of the lending is unestablished, and the ethics case was closed without a real investigation (E9). The best next steps are to remove the penalty incentive and to run an independent investigation. Disciplining anyone now, or identifying the reporter, would be harmful.
